operator-walkthrough.ref: Text-to-apply (job 2026-10-30-tech-hiring-page W1). What a visitor sees: /careers hero gains a third button 'Text Us to Apply' (44 px tap target); each /careers/<slug> job page gains 'Text us to apply' beside Call, plus one line: 'Texting opens a message to the shop with the job filled in. Add your name and send.' Tapping opens the phone's texts to the shop line (BUSINESS.phone.raw) prefilled 'JOB-APPLY <role>. My name is '. What Nour sees: the text lands in the admin SMS inbox as before, one candidates row with source 'sms' appears in Leads > Candidates (one per text, even if the response job re-runs), and the existing candidate owner alert (store line to his mobile, CANDIDATE_OWNER_SMS switch) fires. If the row cannot be saved and there is no job to retry, he gets one internal text naming the last four digits. The customer reply bot does not answer that text, and a photo sent with it does not get the car-photo reply. A token text ending in STOP (or saying unsubscribe, stop texting, opt out) is recorded as an opt-out and answered with nothing. Texts without the leading token, including 'are you hiring' or 'job openings for a tech', keep the normal customer flow. Live screenshots at 390x844 and 1440x900 follow after deploy.
